ocr.notes: Some names dropped ('Stephen' Frazee, Deputy Sheriff 'Bagby').

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen was the first man arrested on the McManus-Flint prize-fight warrants, taken just before breakfast and released on $500 bond to appear at Union, Franklin County.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Wednesday, April 18, 1888, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen was the first arrested on Franklin County warrants over the McManus-Flint prize fight; he gave $500 bond at the Four Courts to appear before Justice Stephen Frazee at Union

notes: Focus raised to primary: the item leads with and is mostly about Allen's arrest, though others were also arrested.
